item.title: Tri-Valley celebrates Hanukkah while honoring Bondi Beach victims
item.description: In the wake of a mass shooting this past weekend during a Hanukkah celebration at Bondi Beach in Australia, Rabbis within Tri-Valley’s Jewish community remain undaunted through their mourning as local organizations are scheduled to host events this week in observance of the holiday. item.title: Interim LPFD Chief Lacey named permanent leader
item.description: Aaron Lacey, a longtime Livermore Pleasanton Fire Department employee who had been serving as the interim chief since August, has been officially appointed as the department’s new chief, according to a joint press release from the two Tri-Valley cities. item.title: PUSD budget update shows higher deficit than staff initially projected
item.description: The Pleasanton Unified School District Board of Trustees recently approved the district’s First Interim Budget Report for its 2025-26 fiscal year, which indicated some small improvements in the district’s financials; however, the deficit is still $3 million more than what staff had hoped for going into the new year.
